item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Take a moment to ask yourself whether your routine around it is actually working. Do you take it at the same time each day, and do you have a simple way to know whether you did? Missed doses and guesswork quietly undermine everything else you're building. Today, anchor it to something you already do reliably, like a meal or a set evening habit. Then set one daily reminder on your phone.
